title: bug 61: cmd_lint crashes on an empty body
body:
Parent: #1

The crash is in `scripts/wave.py`, in `cmd_lint`.

## Reprodução

1. Run `wave lint` against an issue whose body is empty.
2. Watch it crash.

   ```
   KeyError: 'body'
   ```

## Done when

- [ ] the empty input is rejected (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`) — owner: implementer

## Handoff

```bash
git worktree add -b fix/61-empty ../r-61 origin/main
```
